source.quote: The national atomic company of Kazakhstan has announced plans for a roughly 10% cut in its uranium production in 2026, saying it does not view the current supply-demand balance and existing uncovered demand as sufficient to incentivise a return to its 100% levels at this time.

headline: Kazatomprom announces a roughly 10% cut in planned 2026 uranium production

source.quote: The 2026 production guidance remains subject to sulphuric acid availability.

headline: Kazatomprom says 2026 production guidance remains subject to sulphuric acid availability

source.quote: construction works in the affected area have been suspended pending official permit from relevant state authorities to resume work.

headline: Kazatomprom: construction at the TQZ sulphuric acid plant site suspended after specimens found

source.quote: Based on the information currently available, these measures do not prohibit sulphuric acid exports. Rather, they introduce a revised approval procedure for export volumes, which is expected to remain in effect until 31 December 2026.

headline: Kazatomprom on Russia's revised approval procedure for sulphuric acid exports (Resolution 1158)
